notes_zh:
- **新增** 搜索支持空格拆分（多关键词并集匹配）：输入 `aaa bbb` 会找同时包含两词的条目，CJK 也适用（如 `学习 笔记`）
- **新增** 纯文本预览中匹配的关键词高亮显示（多关键词都会高亮，CJK / 英文均支持）
- **优化** 搜索输入响应更跟手（防抖时间从 200ms 缩短到 80ms）
- **优化** 大体量历史下粘贴更流畅（过期清理查询从全表扫描改为索引层过滤）
- **修复** 搜索时右上角数量徽章未跟随过滤结果更新（之前一直显示历史总数）
notes_en:
- **New** Multi-keyword search via space (AND semantics): typing `aaa bbb` matches items containing both terms — works for CJK too (e.g. `学习 笔记`)
- **New** Highlight matched terms in plain-text preview (all keywords are highlighted; works for both ASCII and CJK)
- **Improve** Snappier search input (debounce reduced from 200ms to 80ms)
- **Improve** Smoother paste on large clipboard histories (expiration scan now uses SQL-level filtering instead of a full table fetch)
- **Fix** Count badge in the top-right not updating to reflect filtered results during search (previously kept showing total history count)

beta.notes_zh:
- **修复** 进一步修复在 Windows 远程桌面、UU 远程等远程桌面中粘贴失败、只粘出一个 “v” 的问题——改为在系统底层注入按键，让远程客户端能正确识别为粘贴（#60，感谢 @vvair 的反馈与定位）
- **优化** 快捷面板窗口拖窄、收起预览区时，列表自动切换为更紧凑的单行布局，一屏看到更多记录

⚠️ **这是 Beta 测试版本**。建议在非关键环境体验，问题反馈到 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/lifedever/PasteMemo-app/issues)。Beta 稳定后会自动升级到正式版。

---
beta.notes_en:
- **Fix** Further fix for pasting into remote desktops (Windows Remote Desktop, UU Remote, etc.) that only produced a “v” — keystrokes are now injected at the system's lowest level so remote clients recognize them as a paste (#60, thanks @vvair for the report and diagnosis)
- **Improve** When the Quick Panel is narrowed and the preview pane collapses, the list switches to a tighter single-line layout so you can see more items at a glance

⚠️ **This is a beta release.** Please test on non-critical machines and report issues on [GitHub](https://github.com/lifedever/PasteMemo-app/issues). You'll be auto-upgraded to the stable release once the beta stabilizes.
